newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Korea's KEPCO buys June LSWR from Vitol, Ssangyong.
newsitem.headline: Korea's KEPCO buys June LSWR from Vitol, Ssangyong.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) has awarded its tender to buy two 600,000-barrel cargoes of low sulphur waxy residue for June delivery to Dutch trader Vitol and South Korea's Ssangyong Corp, traders said on Tuesday.
KEPCO purchased a 600,000-barrel cargo at $17.70 per barrel for June 26-30 delivery from Vitol and a similar sized cargo for June 3-7 delivery from Ssangyong at $18.25.
Both cargoes were priced on a cost-and-freight basis and will be delivered to the ports of Ulsan or Pusan.
The tender closed on April 15 and was valid for one day.
KEPCO last purchased 500,000 barrels of May LSWR from Vitol at $18.55 for delivery between May 11-15 c-and-f.
